notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed 2 missing collectibles in Forge's Hellevator and Love Letters levels.
[*] Modified menu hotkeys to work on key release instead of key press to help address issues with holding jump at the level end.
[/list]

notes.title: Speedrun Saturday
notes.content:
[h1]Come watch the devs race![/h1]

At Noon CST, turn into www.twitch.tv/teknedia and watch the devs race each other.

Who will reign supreme?? Come find out!

notes.title: Patch 1 Released
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have implemented a minor patch to fix some issues with the release build.

[list]
[*] Fixed broken thumbnails on the Forge world level select screen
[*] Fixed missing textures in some Forge levels
[*] Fixed rendering bug with mine explosions
[/list]

notes.title: Teknedia Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]It's here![/h1] 

The wait is over! The future is now! The present is the past!

It is has been a long road, but it is done. Teknedia is available on Steam! We sincerely hope you enjoy the game.

<3 Your friends at Stache Studios

[h2]Release Day Streaming![/h2]

Starting at 4pm CST, Brian will be streaming the game. Come hang out and celebrate with us.

[h2]Speedrun Saturday[/h2]

From noon-2pm CST on 1/9/2021, watch us play and try to post some top times.

notes.title: Releasing in 3 Days!
notes.content:
[h1]It's happening![/h1]

What better way to start the new year that to release a new game?

Mark your calendars, add us to your wishlist, and get ready to jump through the neon soaked world of Teknedia.

[h2]More things happening this week:[/h2]

[h3]Release Day Stream[/h3]
Starting at 2pm CST on 1/8/2021, join Brian as he streams the game on release day. Chat, watch, and give him hell when makes mistakes.

[h3]Saturday Speedruns[/h3]
Join us from noon-2pm CST as we try to get stamp down the best times we can.

notes.title: Teknedia SGF Live Stream
notes.content:
[h2]Duck out of work early, and come watch us stream Teknedia![/h2]

Watch Ian and Brian play Teknedia as they talk about the game, what it was like to make it, and answer any questions y'all have!

All of the following will (probably) be answered:
[list]
[*]What is this game?
[*]Why does it exist?
[*]What does Teknedia mean?
[*]Why is Ian bad at the game still?
[*]Is Brian a jerk for writing that?
[*][b]And (mostly) whatever you ask![/b]
[/list]
